# Flaghoist documentation

> Flaghoist is an open-source, OpenFeature-native feature-flag service you self-host: run it on Cloudflare Workers (or Node, Bun, Deno), store flags in Cloudflare KV, Redis, or Postgres, and read them from any language through standard OpenFeature OFREP providers. Boolean flags, sticky percentage rollouts, and ordered targeting rules. Pre-alpha, Apache-2.0.

## Start here
- [Introduction](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/): what Flaghoist is and why.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/quickstart/): from nothing to a deployed flag service and a first flag.
- [Architecture](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/architecture/): how the read path, admin API, storage, and dashboard fit together.

## Reading flags from your app
- [Overview](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/): OpenFeature and OFREP, and how to pick a provider.
- [JavaScript and TypeScript](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/javascript/)
- [Go](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/go/)
- [Python](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/python/)
- [Java](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/java/)
- [.NET](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/dotnet/)
- [Ruby](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/ruby/)
- [Rust](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/clients/rust/)

## Running it
- [Self-hosting](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/self-hosting/): storage adapters, rate limiting, and deployment targets.
- [Deployment targets](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/deploy/overview/): Cloudflare Workers, Docker, Render, Node, Bun, Deno, or a container.
- [Deploy with Docker](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/deploy/docker/): one portable, env-configured image that runs on any container host (VPS, Fly.io, Railway, Cloud Run, ECS, Kubernetes).
- [Deploy to Render](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/deploy/render/): run it as a Render web service backed by Render Postgres, no Cloudflare account needed.
- [Deploy to Fly.io](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/deploy/fly/): run the container on Fly.io with Fly Postgres.
- [Deploy to Railway](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/deploy/railway/): run the container on Railway with a Railway Postgres.
- [Authentication](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/auth/): API key, bearer token, and OIDC.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/dashboard/): the admin UI.
- [CLI](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/cli/): scaffold, deploy, eject, and flag management.
- [API reference](https://docs.flaghoist.dev/api-reference/): OFREP read endpoints and the admin CRUD API, including conditional writes via If-Match.
